speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: asked	the Minister for Manpower what is the rationale for the Ministry's reluctance to provide a breakdown of the number of foreign domestic workers in Singapore by nationality.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Perhaps, the Minister of State can clarify this further and would the Ministry reconsider this position?

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: I remember at the last Sitting, the Member also asked the same question.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: With regard to the population's statistics in Australia, I remember the Deputy Prime Minister, in one of his Committee of Supply speeches, had addressed that.

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: In Australia, you hardly see any foreign domestic workers.
